3.t: And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is

4.t: ˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster

5.t: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast

6.t: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind

7.t: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
7.tr: Sakkhara-haa 'alaihim sab'a la-yaalinw Wa-samaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral qawma feehaa sar'aa ka-annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah

8.t: Do you see any of them left alive

9.t: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin
9.tr: Wa-jaaa'a Firawnu Wa-man qablahoo wal-mu'tafikaatu bil-khaati'ah

10.t: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip
10.tr: Fa'asaw Rasoola Rabbihim fa-akhazahum akhzatar raabiyah

11.t: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺
11.tr: Innaa lammaa taghal maaa'u hamalnaakum fil jaariyah

12.t: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it
12.tr: Li-naj'alahaa lakum tazki-ratanw-wa ta'iyahaa uzununw waa'iyah

13.t: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast
13.tr: Fa-izaa nufikha fis soori nafkhatunw waahidah

14.t: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow
14.tr: Wa-humilatil ardu wal-jibaalu fadukkataa dakkatanw waahidah

15.t: on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass

16.t: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail

17.t: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them
17.tr: Wal-malaku 'alaaa arjaaa'ihaa; Wa-yahmilu 'Arsha Rabbika fawqahum yawma'izin samaaniyah

18.t: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden
18.tr: Yawma'izin tu'radoona laa takhfaa min-kum khaafiyah

19.t: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record
19.tr: Fa-ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa-yaqoolu haaa'umuq ra'oo kitaabiyah

20.t: I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”

21.t: They will be in a life of bliss

23.t: whose fruit will hang within reach

24.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”
24.tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee'am bimaaa aslaftum fil ayyaamil khaliyah

25.t: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record
25.tr: Wa-ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo bishimaalihee fa-yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam oota kitaaabiyah

26.t: nor known anything of my reckoning

27.t: I wish death was the end

28.t: My wealth has not benefited me

29.t: My authority has been stripped from me.”

30.t: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them

32.t: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long
32.tr: Summa fee silsilatin zar'uhaa sab'oona ziraa'an faslukooh

33.t: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest

34.t: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor

35.t: So this Day they will have no close friend here

37.t: which none will eat except the evildoers.”

38.t: Now, I do swear by whatever you see

40.t: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger

41.t: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith
41.tr: Wa-maa huwa biqawli shaa'ir; qaleelan maa tu'minoon

42.t: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful
42.tr: Wa-laa biqawli kaahin; qaleelan maa tazakkaroon

43.t: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

44.t: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name

45.t: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand

47.t: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺

48.t: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺

49.t: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial

50.t: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers

51.t: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth

52.t: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
